comment: Dependencies whose copyleft or odd licence was reviewed and accepted. scripts/licence_check.py reports these as WARN with the reason; anything not listed FAILs. Add an entry only with a ruling in docs/DECISIONS.md.

allow.name: pedalboard
allow.reason: GPLv3; allowed only behind the process boundary (native_host.py), until the project licence is chosen
allow.ref: docs/DECISIONS.md, pedalboard process boundary; docs/PLAN.md risks

allow.name: lameenc
allow.reason: LGPL-3.0-or-later MP3 encoder, unmodified, dynamically installed, never called; transitive dependency of demucs via the optional separation extra. Re-review before any bundled or frozen release
